### The flip (GL-GATE-03: "FLIP the OKC critical subset first, reviewer = maintainer (delegated) + date + rights basis quoted from each packet")
Flipped exactly these 6 sources in `connectors/src/connectors/data/sources.toml` to `ingestion_permitted = true`, each with `rights_reviewed_by = "maintainer (delegated)"`, `rights_reviewed_on = 2026-09-10`:

| source | SPDX basis | packet justification |
|---|---|---|
| `okc_procurement` | CC0-1.0 | US municipal government public records are uncopyrightable / public domain (packet: public record ⇒ redistributable; derivatives of underlying facts permitted). `last_verified` 2026-09-10. |
| `okc_council` | CC0-1.0 | OKC council agendas/minutes are government public records (packet same basis). `last_verified` 2026-09-10. |
| `okcpd_policy` | CC0-1.0 | OKCPD Operations Manual §5-118 is an agency policy government public record (packet same basis). `last_verified` 2026-09-10. |
| `ok_statute` | CC0-1.0 | Statutes / edicts of government are not copyrightable in the U.S. — public domain (packet explicit); OSCN terms govern access method only. `last_verified` 2026-09-10. |
| `osm_overpass` | ODbL-1.0 | Existing rights block: redistributable + derivative_permitted true; kept in the separate ODbL compartment (§42.3). Added review metadata + `last_verified` 2026-09-10 (was absent). |
| `deflock_repo` | MIT | Existing rights block: redistributable + derivative_permitted true. Added review metadata; existing `last_verified` 2026-08-20 retained. |

CC0-1.0 is the registry-accepted public-domain SPDX expression (`policy/data/licenses.toml`); the packets' SPDX candidate line was `UNDETERMINED` pending exactly this reviewer determination — GL-GATE-03 is that determination, grounded in each packet's redistributable/derivative analysis. No rights basis fabricated.

- **NOT flipped:** `journalrecord`, `oklahoman` stay LINK-posture / UNDETERMINED per their packets. France/Belgium and all FR/CSS sources untouched (design-gated false).
- **HG-04 NOT satisfied:** no Stage-0 outreach fabricated; `D-P21.1-2` stays OPEN.
